name: "Thom Son Nuht" (as Larry remembers it)
summary: A location Larry remembers as a Company Headquarters. The spelling "Thom Son Nuht" is his son's written transcription of the name as Larry says it — not Larry's own writing — and is not treated as authoritative. The leading research hypothesis is Tân Sơn Nhứt (Tan Son Nhut), the major air base adjacent to Saigon, but this identification is not yet supported by evidence.
larrysRecollection: Larry remembers a location phonetically as "Thom Son Nuht." He remembers this as a Company Headquarters location.
researchNotes: Provenance note: the phonetic spellings of remembered place names in this archive are transcriptions by Larry's son of names Larry says aloud. Tân Sơn Nhứt / Tan Son Nhut is a strong phonetic match and hosted extensive U.S. Army aviation activity in 1964-1965, but the identification remains a hypothesis until unit records place Larry's company headquarters there. Research should also consider other Vietnamese place names, period French spellings, air bases, compounds, and phonetically similar names before settling the question. No coordinates are recorded until the identification is settled.
